description: Header file for XR Voice SDK providing definitions, structures, and function prototypes for initializing, versioning, logging, and thread polling of the voice SDK.

methods.name: vsdk_version
methods.description: Retrieves detailed version information for the voice SDK components.

methods.name: vsdk_init
methods.description: Initializes the voice SDK component with optional ANSI color codes.

methods.name: vsdk_init_user_print
methods.description: Initializes the voice SDK with external logging functions.

methods.name: vsdk_term
methods.description: Terminates the voice SDK and frees resources.

methods.name: vsdk_log_level_get
methods.description: Retrieves the current log level for a specified module.

methods.name: vsdk_log_level_set
methods.description: Sets the log level for a specified module.

methods.name: vsdk_log_level_set_all
methods.description: Sets the log level for all modules.

methods.name: vsdk_thread_poll
methods.description: Polls VSDK threads to check responsiveness and calls a callback if responsive.
